consent_records_tenant_isolation.name: consent_records_tenant_isolation
consent_records_tenant_isolation.using:
exists (
        select 1 from users
        inner join identities on identities.user_id = users.id
        where users.id = consent_records.user_id
          and identities.id = consent_records.identity_id
          and users.auth_subject = nullif(current_setting('app.auth_subject', true), '')
      )
consent_records_tenant_isolation.withCheck:
exists (
        select 1 from users
        inner join identities on identities.user_id = users.id
        where users.id = consent_records.user_id

      )

consent_state_timestamp_invariant.name: consent_state_timestamp_invariant
consent_state_timestamp_invariant.value:
("consent_records"."state" = 'GRANTED' and "consent_records"."withdrawn_at" is null)
        or ("consent_records"."state" = 'WITHDRAWN' and "consent_records"."withdrawn_at" is not null and "consent_records"."withdrawn_at" >= "consent_records"."granted_at")

provider_runs_terminal_invariant.name: provider_runs_terminal_invariant
provider_runs_terminal_invariant.value:
("provider_runs"."state" = 'RUNNING' AND "provider_runs"."health_outcome" IS NULL
          AND "provider_runs"."result_count" IS NULL AND "provider_runs"."error_safe_code" IS NULL AND "provider_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("provider_runs"."state" = 'COMPLETED' AND "provider_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "provider_runs"."result_count" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_runs"."error_safe_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("provider_runs"."state" = 'FAILED' AND "provider_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "provider_runs"."error_safe_code" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_runs"."result_count" IS NULL)

provider_usage_costs_nonnegative.name: provider_usage_costs_nonnegative
provider_usage_costs_nonnegative.value: "provider_usage_reservations"."estimated_cost_units" >= 0 AND ("provider_usage_reservations"."actual_cost_units" IS NULL OR "provider_usage_reservations"."actual_cost_units" BETWEEN 0 AND "provider_usage_reservations"."estimated_cost_units")

provider_usage_terminal_invariant.name: provider_usage_terminal_invariant
provider_usage_terminal_invariant.value:
("provider_usage_reservations"."state" = 'RESERVED' AND "provider_usage_reservations"."actual_cost_units" IS NULL AND "provider_usage_reservations"."terminal_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("provider_usage_reservations"."state" IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND "provider_usage_reservations"."actual_cost_units" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_usage_reservations"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("provider_usage_reservations"."state" = 'RELEASED' AND "provider_usage_reservations"."actual_cost_units" IS NULL AND "provider_usage_reservations"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL)

scan_jobs_lease_invariant.name: scan_jobs_lease_invariant

        OR ("scan_jobs"."state" <> 'CLAIMED' AND "scan_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "scan_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

scans_terminal_invariant.name: scans_terminal_invariant
scans_terminal_invariant.value:
("scans"."state" IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND "scans"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("scans"."state" IN ('PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
          AND "scans"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "scans"."completed_at" >= "scans"."started_at")

verification_delivery_outbox_insert_only.name: verification_delivery_outbox_insert_only
verification_delivery_outbox_insert_only.withCheck:
exists (
        select 1 from identifier_verifications
        inner join identifiers on identifiers.id = identifier_verifications.identifier_id
        inner join identities on identities.id = identifiers.identity_id
        inner join users on users.id = identities.user_id
        where identifier_verifications.id = verification_delivery_outbox.verification_id
          and users.id = verification_delivery_outbox.user_id
          and users.auth_subject = nullif(current_setting('app.auth_subject', true), '')
      )

verification_delivery_outbox_payload_sta.name: verification_delivery_outbox_payload_state_invariant
verification_delivery_outbox_payload_sta.value:
("verification_delivery_outbox"."state" IN ('COMPLETED', 'DEAD_LETTERED', 'CANCELLED') AND "verification_delivery_outbox"."encrypted_payload" IS NULL)
        OR ("verification_delivery_outbox"."state" IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED') AND "verification_delivery_outbox"."encrypted_payload" IS NOT NULL)
